vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling A woman, maybe 40s, with a wiry build about A man, maybe 40s, with restless hands. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Hannah telling A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek about Carmela. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Penelope, Carmela and Ingrid met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Carmela, Ingrid are hurt.
🛡️ Penelope, Carmela, Michelle, Marcus and Ingrid met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Penelope, Carmela, Michelle, Ingrid are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Penelope, Carmela, Lasairfhiona, Rafael and Ingrid met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Penelope, Rafael are hurt.
🛡️ Penelope, Carmela, Lasairfhiona, Michelle and Hannah met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Penelope, Lasairfhiona, Michelle, Hannah are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ingrid just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lasairfhiona just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carmela just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marcus just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Carmela and Marcus met them at the door — 2 put down. Carmela, Marcus are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Penelope just put down The Suburb... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Penelope just put down The Influencer... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
